summary: Baidu, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on September 28, 2026, attaching a Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return for on-market repurchases of Class A ordinary shares (HKEX: 09888) between September 7 and September 28, 2026. Roughly 583,700 to 589,050 shares were bought daily at prices ranging HKD 84.8759 to HKD 92.383, each representing about 0.025% of issued shares. The shares are held for cancellation but not yet cancelled; total issued Class A shares remain 2,209,541,178. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The steady daily buybacks signal ongoing capital return, with completion of cancellations and further repurchases the key watch items.
